title: Torn envelope.
html_source: “A strip of torn envelope peeped from under the dimpled pillow.” Bloom remembers that Molly hid Boylan’s letter under her pillow after she read it while he prepared her breakfast. He is thinking about Boylan, a “friend of the family”.
